Use case: ui-mockup. A premium production-quality COMPLETE website UI mockup for azərtur, Azerbaijan inbound travel, English interface. Original design continuing the approved homepage in reference image 1. Warm white #FAF8F4, charcoal #202624, restrained orange #EE7845 rectangular primary buttons, forest #304B3D, pale sage sections, modern Manrope-like confident sans-serif. Sharp 4px corners, thin rules, fine line icons, generous editorial whitespace. Use full canvas from navigation to COMPLETE footer, readable crisp text, aligned exact grid. No device frames, perspective, moodboard, pills, badges, eyebrows, neon, decorative gradients, heavy shadows, fake reviews, invented customer counts, scarcity or discounts. Image 1 is STYLE/BRAND reference, NOT page to reproduce. Subsequent references are actual project photographic ASSETS to reuse faithfully inside this new page, not new destinations. Show prices as sample indicative amounts, never guaranteed availability or instant booking. Customer selects options then registers and submits a request for operator review; contract approval and deposit occur only after operator confirms offer. No payment or contract actions on this screen. Cancellation policy varies by service/provider and request timing, no universal percentage or deadline.
Asset type: ONE SINGLE COMPLETE FULL-LENGTH MOBILE WEBSITE CATALOG screenshot, desired 780px wide by 3840px tall, representing a real 390 CSS pixel screen at 2x. NOT a phone frame, not desktop shrunk down, not two side-by-side screens, not just hero. Full page from top header to full footer, ample 24 logical pixel margins, readable mobile typography and touch targets. Reuse photo reference image2 Khinalug, image3 Sheki, image4 Baku. Compact mobile header orange A + azərtur on left, "EN" and menu icon right. No desktop navbar.
1. Breadcrumb Home / Tours, large mobile title "Find your kind of journey." and concise supporting "A starting point for your Azerbaijan trip." Broad shallow mountain photo.
2. A clear stacked search form, rows Destination "All destinations", Travel dates "Choose dates", Travelers "2 travelers", full width rectangular orange "Find a journey", helper "Final quote confirmed by our team."
3. Quiet line-icon tourism selector in 3 columns x 2 rows: History, Culture, Medical, Nature, Entertainment, Business, no pills.
4. Toolbar "3 sample journeys", labelled rectangular "Filters" button with sliders icon and native sort dropdown. IMPORTANT: filter sidebar is collapsed on mobile; do not put desktop checkboxes across whole page.
5. ONE-COLUMN list of exactly three compact but photo-led large tour cards, photos faithfully reused from references, no badges/rating/favorite buttons:
Quba · Khinalug / Into the highlands / "2 days · Moderate" / "From €240 / person" / "Sample price" / "View itinerary →";
Sheki · Gabala / Along the Silk Road / "3 days · Easy" / "From €410 / person" / "Sample price" / "View itinerary →";
Baku · Old City / A city of contrasts / "1 day · Easy" / "From €85 / person" / "Sample price" / "View itinerary →".
Each photo wide 16:9, copy below photo on warm white with generous hierarchy and subtle line separation. No invented extra tours. Keep card headings large, all prices aligned and legible.
6. Small explanatory "Prices are illustrative. Final services and quote are confirmed before payment." Then a pale sage section "A different route in mind?" and forest rectangular "Create your trip →".
7. A compact three numbered guidance rows "Browse", "Customize", "Send a request", a "Get in touch →" text link, and complete forest-green mobile footer with logo, Explore links, Company links, Information links, EN / RU / AZ, © 2026 azərtur. Footer content fully visible, no cropped bottom.
This is a proposed static design, all photo/copy/buttons aligned, consistent with reference homepage. Prioritize real mobile hierarchy, do not compress desktop grid into miniature.

1. Compact white header orange A + azərtur left, EN and hamburger right, fine bottom rule.
2. "← Back to tours", heading "Into the highlands", subhead "Two days. Village paths. A different pace." A clean 2x2 line-icon facts block "Quba · Khinalug", "2 days, 1 night", "Moderate", "Starts in Baku". Small "Sample itinerary".
3. Full-width mountain village gallery photo and two small thumbnail images guesthouse and hikers beneath, a quiet "View all photos" control.
4. Compact anchor text nav Overview / Itinerary / Services, thin active underline, no pills.
5. SINGLE inline request/options panel with fine border. "From €240 / person", "Sample starting price"; labelled date selector "Choose date", travelers "2 adults"; "Estimated total €480", note "Final quote confirmed by our team." Full-width orange "Customize this trip →" and small "Sign in to send your request". No pay now or instant booking.
6. Section "A little further from the everyday." short paragraph "Village paths, wide valleys and a night away from the everyday. Follow the road north at your own pace." Three tiny line-icon benefit rows Mountain village walks / Local hospitality / Scenic roads.
7. "Your route, day by day." Compact schematic typographic route Baku → Quba → Khinalug → Baku, label "Route overview", not a map. Two mobile accordion/timeline rows. First open: "Day 1 — From the city to the mountains" with "Leave Baku, pause in Quba and continue towards Khinalug. Walk village paths and settle into your selected stay." Second open: "Day 2 — A slow morning. A scenic return." with "A mountain walk before returning to Baku." Note "Timing depends on weather and your final itinerary."
8. "Choose what goes into your trip." Four compact fine-line icon rows Transfers / Local guide / Overnight stay / Experiences, all with "Selected separately". Note "Flights, visas and personal expenses excluded. Itemized prices appear in your quote."
9. Pale sage compact panel "Make this route yours." and forest rectangular "Open trip planner →".
10. "Before you go" quiet accordion rows "What should I bring?", "How is my request confirmed?", "Contracts and payments", "Changes and cancellation". Cancellation expanded answer "Terms vary by service, provider and cancellation time. Our team reviews your request before confirming any refund." No refund percentage or blanket deadline.
11. Compact "Keep exploring" with two text/photo rows for existing tours "Along the Silk Road" 3 days / From €410 sample and "A city of contrasts" 1 day / From €85 sample; use tiny photos from supplied reference5/6 if supplied.
12. Complete forest-green footer with azərtur, navigation, EN RU AZ, ©2026. Under footer a SINGLE persistent-looking orange/white mobile action bar "From €240" and "Customize trip →", no pay-now copy. It must not obscure any page text in the composite screenshot, allocate footer clearance.
Full page polished consistent spacing, complete footer no clipping. Design for real one-handed mobile reading; no cramped desktop columns.
